mappedContracts.statement: Replace @modelcontextprotocol/sdk v1 with the newest v2 split packages and explicitly adopt MCP protocol revision 2026-07-28 in mainline.
acceptanceCriteria: Use the official codemod as a starting point and complete the manual migration.
Use @modelcontextprotocol/server plus the appropriate Node/Hono middleware packages and Standard Schema validators.
Remove v1 imports and dead compatibility code except a deliberate dual-era transport adapter.
Adopt 2026-07-28 stateless requests, header routing, deterministic/cacheable lists, MRTR support, authorization hardening, and extensions.

mappedContracts.statement: Serve MCP 2026-07-28 explicitly with the stateless core, self-describing requests, header-based routing, deterministic/cacheable catalogues, and per-request capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Streamable HTTP uses the official v2 handler and current Node/Hono adapter.
tools/list, resources/list, and prompts/list have deterministic order and validated cache hints.
Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name routing is tested.

mappedContracts.statement: Provide first-class stdio and Streamable HTTP transports from the same capability registry, with deliberate legacy-era compatibility rather than duplicated servers.
acceptanceCriteria: serveStdio or its current official equivalent explicitly supports the selected protocol era.
The HTTP server is stateless and horizontally safe.
No legacy HTTP+SSE implementation is newly adopted.

mappedContracts.statement: Implement current MCP authorization hardening for remote distribution, including issuer validation, credential isolation, scope step-up, client metadata documents, TLS, and least privilege.
acceptanceCriteria: Remote mode never shares Substack credentials across users, issuers, or publications.
Local stdio remains available without unnecessary remote auth complexity.
Smithery/hosted distribution has a documented credential model and privacy boundary.
